query:
SELECT block_height,
               SUM(amount_xor)              AS "total_xor: bigdecimal::BigDecimal",
               COALESCE(SUM(usd_value), 0)  AS "total_usd: bigdecimal::BigDecimal",
               COUNT(*)                     AS "rows!"
        FROM sm.fees
        WHERE block_height = ANY($1) AND amount_xor > 0 AND amount_xor <= 100
        GROUP BY block_height
